rolling.rule: on each test day, the configs with n >= 60 and a 95 % lower bound of the expectancy > 0 over the 30 sessions before it; one trade per symbol, the config with the higher lower bound when several fire

best_days.warning: the rolling total is not positive; there is no profit share to split

note: Every config matched a rule on past 5-minute bars, after costs; none is a prediction. configs_tested counts every config in the grid: with that many, something looks good by luck. Approved means the out-of-sample record cleared the gate, not that the next trade wins. Most people who day trade lose money.
